scope: gate local integrado executado em clone candidate-bound descartável com checkout Git limpo

candidate.source_after_identity: somente commits documentais de identidade, snapshots Triple-A/P0 e evidência; nenhuma mudança de código, lockfile, workflow ou configuração após o source_sha

environment: Linux local; Node v22.23.2; pnpm 10.33.0; Helm v3.15.4; PostgreSQL descartável; dados sintéticos; sem secrets reais, provider, target, OCI, deploy, push, UAT ou release

commands.command: CI=1 DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=/dev/null pnpm security:enterprise && pnpm security:secrets
CI=1 DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=/dev/null pnpm test:migration-harness (retry after transient connection termination)

contracts.supply_chain: 132 actions, 14 workflow images, 15 Compose images, 6 Docker bases, 4 runtime images; immutable

notes: The first migration-harness attempt ended with Connection terminated unexpectedly; the disposable environment was inspected and the immediate retry passed all scenarios and cleanup.

The first docs gate exposed a stale Triple-A snapshot because the shared worktree's source changes were uncommitted. In the disposable candidate, current snapshots and P0 registry were rebound to the source SHA and committed as documentation-only descendants; docs, P0 registry, identity and checker then passed.

The initial clean candidate lacked ignored historical artifacts required only by the append-only control-plane checker. The referenced artifacts were copied from the shared worktree into the disposable clone; Git checkout status remained clean and the checker passed 11/11. No shared artifact was modified.
limitations: The candidate is a disposable local snapshot, not a published or remote candidate; no CI/OCI/SBOM/scan/attestation, target, restore/rollback/RPO/RTO, soak, provider, UAT, accessibility sign-off or release authority was proven.
The runtime matrix ran on the immutable source SHA; subsequent candidate commits were documentation/control-only and are explicitly permitted by the candidate identity contract.
The shared worktree remains dirty by design and was not cleaned, stashed, reset, committed, pushed or deployed.
